question: In a certain code language, “REPORT” is written as “SDQNSS”, and “THANKS” is written as “UGBMLR”. How will “WINTER” be written in that language?
solution:
Here, the alphabets and their positions are shown as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72a30b8cfc6309b36506bcbabb6647d5379494fca9023856cca8a5a79bf064f.png] 

The logic here is: For each word, the odd letters are added by 1 and the even letters are subtracted by 1 to get the code language.

So, for the word REPORT:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df548abde1ba967bf0595e95019cb3088ea4e7db620d24d8732189f9bf3998c2.png] 

And, for the word THANKS:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e63f2eaae2634282bba854ad03b62cadf9946f1a44ed6191a83e8c5bb1df55c8.png] 

Thus, for the word WINTER:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed78095a00f15dc2739170ee3cfd978e0fccdb524aa96515910572d0545ce9a7.png] 

Hence, the correct option is** 1.**

**Confusion Point:** Keep in mind the positions of all the letters.
